body: Language model (LM) alignment improves model outputs to reflect human preferences while preserving the capabilities of the base model. The most common alignment approaches are (i) reinforcement learning, which maximizes the expected reward under a KL-divergence constraint, and (ii) best-of-NNN alignment, which selects the highest-reward output among NNN independent samples. Despite their widespread use, the fundamental limits of reward improvement under a KL budget remain poorly understood. summaryZh: 语言模型对齐的理论限制。语言模型（LM）对齐改进了模型输出以反映人类偏好，同时保留基础模型的功能。最常见的对齐方法是 (i) 强化学习，它在 KL 散度约束下最大化预期奖励，以及 (ii) best-of-NNN 对齐，它在 NNN 独立样本中选择最高奖励输出。
